source: 시안 — 저장소를 만들기 전(2026-10-30) 손으로 쓴 지시문. 설계표(traits·worlds)의 바탕이 됐다
prompt:
CONCEPT: a citizen of the Iron Nation — the nation of the element of tools, weapons and blood: heavy, grounded, industrious, slowly rusting. Each citizen is a personification of one substance or use of that element.
CITIZEN: RUSTED ARMOR (the past). A female personification character with an old rusted iron armor as her motif — the armor reimagined as a woman who WEARS it as her own costume at full scale: dark iron plates flaking into orange-brown rust, pitted and layered, rust-red hair, oxidised patina creeping over the metal, worn leather straps, the look of something buried and dug up. Nothing in her hands.
ERA: THE PAST — the early Iron Age, around 500 BC, a Hallstatt-Celtic hill fort: a smoky smithy with a stone forge, bog-iron bloom, hammered iron bars, wooden palisade and autumn hills behind. Costume and setting follow that period exactly; no fantasy magic, no modern material.
STYLE: Polished 2.5D game key art with clean linework, controlled anime facial design, layered cel-to-soft shading and crisp costume and prop detail. Use a vivid, readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.
